description: Unofficial Firey fan art from Battle for Dream Island. Independently drawn friendly orange-and-yellow object character with original line-limb walking, empty cool plastic-cup balancing, gentle contour tidying, intact paper-fleck nudging and a small knee-powered hop. Firey is presented as a stylized light-like cartoon; no real heating, burning, smoke or damage is depicted.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
